_comment: Hand-kept corrections merged over components.schemas by tools/build_catalog.py. The spec's clip properties types are stale, so their fields are annotated (and extended); the source-item fields sit on BaseClipProperties so every clip properties subtype accepts them. The annotations come from the team's Tenant API DX feedback (2026-11-25). status: required = the server rejected a request without it; used = it changed the output; sent = present in a working request but not tested alone; unknown = seen in web UI task parameters, effect unknown. A property listed here replaces the spec's type only when 'type' is given; its description is appended to the spec's.

BaseClipProperties.description_append: The source-item fields copied from GetMediaItem (ItemId, FolderPathId, FolderId, MachineId, DriveId, FullPath, SourceFilename, Filename, FileName, LiveTvSessionInfo) are accepted on every clip properties type; the team's DX feedback saw them in working requests.

ItemId.description: The source media item's Id. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

FolderPathId.description: Copied from GetMediaItem. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

FolderId.description: Copied from GetMediaItem. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

MachineId.description: Copied from GetMediaItem (FolderPathMachineId). Not in the OpenAPI spec.

DriveId.description: Copied from GetMediaItem. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

FullPath.description: Copied from GetMediaItem. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

SourceFilename.description: Copied from GetMediaItem (Filename). Not in the OpenAPI spec.

Filename.description: Copied from GetMediaItem. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

FileName.description: Sent alongside Filename in a working request. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

LiveTvSessionInfo.description: {SessionId: empty GUID, LiveSessionStartIso: recording start, UTC}. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

ClipProperties.description_append: Field names are case-sensitive: the server silently drops a key whose case does not match (lowercase 'subtitles' is ignored).

ClipPropertiesType.description: 1 (Clip) works for both ClipFile and AiClipDesigner.

StartPosition.description: 100 ns ticks from the start of the source file (seconds x 10,000,000).

EndPosition.description: 100 ns ticks from the start of the source file (seconds x 10,000,000); after StartPosition.

DestinationFolderId.description: Library folder for the finished clip.

VariantId.description: Sent as the empty GUID (the original).

Orientation.description: UNRESOLVED: the spec says 0 = Vertical, 1 = Horizontal, 2 = Square; a live test rendered 1 as vertical 1080x1920. Confirm before relying on a value.

Layout.description: 0 = Auto was used in a working request.

Subtitles.description: Capital S. Lowercase 'subtitles' is dropped without an error.

SubtitleTemplateId.description: For example blocky-bounce or classic; the full list is unknown.

TitleTemplateId.description: For example classic; the full list is unknown.

SubtitleX.description: Appears to be a percentage of the frame.

SubtitleY.description: Appears to be a percentage of the frame.

FontWeight.description: A string such as "500", not a number.

BaseTextColor.description: 8-digit hex; the last two digits are alpha.

BackgroundColor.description: 8-digit hex; the last two digits are alpha.

WordHighlightColor.description: 8-digit hex; the last two digits are alpha.

ClipRegionId.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

ThumbnailGeneration.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

IsLiveClip.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

Trimming.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

GenerateLoudnessData.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

GenerateProxy.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

SeriesTitle.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.

EpisodeTitle.description: Seen in web UI task parameters; effect unknown. Not in the OpenAPI spec.
